Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5727832. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727832'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
